author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video to discover how Anyma’s Coachella performance pushed the boundaries of live music visuals. Learn how Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, broadcast AR, and spidercam technology helped bring his world to a vast audience watching online.

Known for his cinematic melodic techno and immersive audiovisual performances, Anyma delivered one of Coachella’s most ambitious shows yet. Towering digital sculptures filled the mainstage screens as the artist performed high above the crowd between massive pillars.
For fans watching on YouTube, the experience went even further. Powered by Unreal Engine, augmented reality visuals—including a giant digital human appearing during LISA’s debut of ‘Bad Angel’—extended Anyma’s world beyond the stage and into the livestream, blurring the line between physical and virtual performance.

title: Expanding Anyma’s Coachella performance into broadcast AR with Unreal Engine
